plan.notes: TERM-BY-TERM SEQUENCE: official Cal Poly 2026-2028 semester catalog "Plan of Study Grid" ("Music"). Flowcharts are the university's suggested sequence; the catalog notes courses may be completed in a different order provided requisite requirements are satisfied. Credit ranges in the source use the LOWER bound (e.g. Technical Elective 3-4 -> 3). "X or Y" rows use the first-listed option as the plan code with alternatives in options. Prereqs not transcribed: the grid does not state them explicitly. PARSE WARNINGS: Term 4 (Second Year Term 2): parsed sum 15.0 != source-stated 16.0 Repeated-enrollment courses (allow_repeated_courses): MU 1150, MU 2250, MU 3350 appear in multiple terms per the official source sequence.
